authority: Web/backend database RPC; clients never create signature nodes, decide prerequisites, signer authority, evidence contents, digest, completion or server time
legal_scope: system-internal handwritten electronic signature and business evidence; no claim of qualified or advanced electronic-signature legal effect

organization_responsible_confirmation.authority: active stable-subject organization role; legacy entity_admin bridges only its operating_entity

policy.versioning: published versions are immutable; frozen requirements keep their version, and a future V2 leaves V1 selectable until V2 effective_from

requirement.source: server policy resolution against an authoritative D11 Requirement Snapshot; an optional admission must match the same person and the Snapshot authoritative actual_project

rpcs.name: training_signature_policy_save_draft
rpcs.restriction: draft only and controlled nodes only

rpcs.name: training_signature_policy_retire
rpcs.effect: stop future selection without changing history

rpcs.name: training_signature_ensure_requirements
rpcs.authorization: eligible record participant or authorized manager
rpcs.effect: idempotently create only policy-defined frozen requirements

rpcs.name: training_signature_requirement_list
rpcs.authorization: record participant or authorized organization/project/company reader
rpcs.privacy: no original image or full identity number

rpcs.name: d15-validate-signature edge handler
rpcs.authorization: current challenge signer JWT; service credentials remain server-side
rpcs.effect: bounded private-object download, PNG/JPEG magic and real decode, actual dimensions/size and SHA-256 validation

rpcs.name: training_signature_submit
rpcs.authorization: same authoritative signer revalidated at submit
rpcs.effect: requires an unchanged authoritative file-validation fact and writes one immutable result per requirement

rpcs.name: training_signature_result_file
rpcs.effect: return exact private object binding for short-lived signed URL

rpcs.name: training_organization_role_grant
rpcs.effect: grant an audited, effective-dated stable-subject organization_unit role

rpcs.name: training_organization_role_revoke
rpcs.effect: revoke organization authority immediately while preserving signed history

rpcs.name: training_signature_supersede_cycle
rpcs.authorization: company administrator or controlled server workflow; employee denied
rpcs.effect: resolve the target Snapshot and effective policy server-side, regenerate the complete node set, retain immutable old evidence and link previous/new cycles
rpcs.idempotency: one successor per person and source event/reference; row lock and uniqueness collapse concurrent retries

prepare_submit.signed_at_binding: submit chooses one server timestamptz before final digest generation; canonical UTC signature_signed_at and the same signed_at are stored atomically
prepare_submit.idempotency: requirement row lock, idempotency key and uniqueness produce one authoritative result; retries return the original signed_at and digest
prepare_submit.concurrency: for ANY_OF, the first valid signer completes the requirement; later valid submits return the existing completion

prerequisites.hard_invariants: signature policy may add signature nodes but cannot waive required D11 training completion or an authoritative D13 exam requirement
prerequisites.management_nodes: organization/project confirmations require all required Snapshot training items completed even when employee acknowledgement nodes are omitted
prerequisites.exam_binding: exact admission, project, person, D13 semantic type, authoritative exam plan and PASS attempt

file.trust: client extension, MIME, size and dimensions are untrusted
file.validation: server reads at most 2 MiB from private Storage, checks magic bytes, fully decodes PNG/JPEG, derives actual type/dimensions/size and SHA-256, and records an immutable validation fact
file.submit_requirement: validation must match requirement, challenge, uploader, object id/version/updated_at and content digest; changed or unvalidated objects are rejected
file.read: private, exact record authorization and short-lived signed URL

identity.live_account: optional reference; disable, close or login deletion does not erase historical signer identity

immutability: signed result, signer, image, digest, role, scope, evidence references and signed_at cannot be updated or deleted through business or direct ordinary-client paths
supersede: a validated authoritative business event creates one complete new cycle from its current Snapshot and effective policy; previous/new cycles are linked and old requirements, signed results, images, digests and audit remain immutable
boundary: D15 records confirmations of existing authoritative facts only; it never completes training, changes D11 completion, changes D13 score/result, or decides D18 work eligibility
